SELECT s.store_id >= 900 AS pseudo, s.store_id, f.channel_id, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(distinct f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.quantity<=0::int) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negs
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND (s.store_id>=900 OR f.staff_purchase_flag OR f.channel_id<>1)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,3,4

SELECT count(*) n, count(distinct sales_line_id) d, count(distinct (receipt_id, line_no)) d2, sum(net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount*(1+vat_rate) - gross_amount > 0.02 OR gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_mismatch FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'

WITH s AS (SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_sales, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT st.store_id, sum(x.refund_net) ret, count(*) n, count(distinct x.return_line_id) dn FROM fact_return_line x JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1),
p AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) b, sum(returns_net) rn, sum(net_sales) ns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(s.store_id,r.store_id,p.store_id) id, s.gross_sales, s.staff, r.ret, r.n, r.dn, p.b, p.rn, p.ns, s.gross_sales - coalesce(r.ret,0) - p.ns AS diff_vs_rpt FROM s FULL JOIN r USING(store_id) FULL JOIN p ON p.store_id = coalesce(s.store_id,r.store_id) ORDER BY abs(coalesce(s.gross_sales - coalesce(r.ret,0) - p.ns,999999)) DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT min(business_date), max(business_date), count(distinct store_id), count(*), sum(CASE WHEN store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pseudo_rows FROM rpt_daily_store_sales

SELECT f.channel_id=1 AS is_store,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date = CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_utc,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', f.sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_hel,
 count(*) n,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) net_by_sale_date,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', f.sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) net_by_hel
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-25' AND DATE '2026-10-03' GROUP BY 1

WITH w AS (SELECT 'cal_sep' k, DATE '2026-09-01' a, DATE '2026-09-30' b UNION ALL SELECT 'fiscal_p05', DATE '2026-08-31', DATE '2026-09-27'),
sales AS (SELECT w.k, sum(f.net_amount) amt FROM w JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date BETWEEN w.a AND w.b JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY w.k),
rets AS (SELECT w.k, sum(r.refund_net) amt FROM w JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.return_date BETWEEN w.a AND w.b JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY w.k)
SELECT sales.k, sales.amt AS sales_before_returns, rets.amt AS returns, sales.amt - rets.amt AS net_sales FROM sales JOIN rets USING (k) ORDER BY 1
